rationale: Roberts is likely to keep the opinion narrow and institutional, holding only that §§ 1681n–1681o, via § 1681a(b)’s definition of “person,” waive immunity as to federal agencies while reserving punitive-damages/remedy questions. Thomas is the most likely dissenter (with Alito possibly joining or writing separately) arguing that a global definition is not an unmistakable money-damages waiver under Lane/Return Mail given remedial anomalies.
